description: Configuration for eligibility package name matching rules. This file defines how claim package names should match with eligibility package names.

matchingRules.description: Thiqa/TC matching: if claim has 'thiqa' and eligibility has 'tc', consider it a match
THIQA variant matching: 'THIQA' or 'TMC - Thiqa' should match 'Thiqa C1', 'Thiqa C2', etc.
DAMAN BASIC variant matching: 'DAMAN BASIC' should match 'Basic' packages and Abu Dhabi I/O style package names
DAMAN Enhanced forward matching: 'Daman Enhanced' should match 'Sahtak', 'Enhanced-*', 'Core-AUH-*', or classifications
DAMAN Enhanced reverse mapping: claim has Enhanced-tier plan name and eligibility says 'Daman Enhanced'

claimSpecialCondition.description: Match 'enhanced' in claim only if 'daman' is NOT present

matchingRules.description: DAMAN Mid variant matching: 'Daman Mid' sits in the same Enhanced tier
DAMAN Key variant matching: 'Daman-Key' should match 'Sahtak' or classifications
DAMAN Low-End variant matching: 'DAMAN Low-End' should match specific plan names, networks, or classifications
Generic DAMAN classification matching: claim starts with 'daman' or has 'daman' after _ or - and eligibility has classification
